newsitem.title: MACEDONIA: MACEDONIA STOCK TURNOVER, VOLUME FALL.
newsitem.headline: MACEDONIA STOCK TURNOVER, VOLUME FALL.

text.p: Turnover and traded volume rose at Tuesday's session of the Macedonian Stock Exchange, the exchange said.
Total turnover fell to 39,165 denars from 774,965 denars with 21 shares changing hands, down from 514 units at the previous trading on Thursday.
A total of 21 Gradski Targovski Centar stocks sold on the first floor at 1,865 denars, unchanged from Thursday but below par of 2,664 denars.
Listed companies trade in two floor sessions. The exchange trades twice a week. ($1=41.31 denars; 1DEM=26.64 denars) -- Sofia Newsroom, 359-2-981 4145
